I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. The store is **Pine Crossing**.

A driver had arrived at 7:10 and the receiver wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis said he would check the shift template and ask support to recreate the problem using the store's login. I couldn't find any later message in the channel saying it was fixed, and I told her that too.

I only looked at channels Pree is in, and didn't need any private information.
